none: PAS FindID 995834: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue, probably of 335-341, Reece period 17, on a small worn flan. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: two soldiers, probably with one standard between them, standard has vexillum with triangular top. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC] ITVS. Diameter: 12.1mm, Weight: 0.56gms, die axis: 12
